summary: Implement a small {{ var|filter }} template renderer with dotted lookup, filters, HTML escaping and error handling.
what_tests_check: Whitespace-tolerant tags, dict/attr/index lookup, missing-variable errors, default filter (missing and None, quoted args with spaces/colons), upper/lower/trim chaining, escaping vs raw, None rendering, backslash-escaped braces, unclosed/empty/unknown-filter errors.
